title: Kitshelf: Atomic admin-utility index + deterministic playback
creator: Sofia Malik
description: Build a curated "kitshelf" of small, composable admin utilities (atomic actions) plus a deterministic playback engine so support engineers can assemble, preview, and run repeatable remediation flows. The intention is to reduce toil for oncall and improve reproducibility for incident postmortems. Kitshelf items are lightweight commandlets (idempotent where possible) with typed inputs, a short README, and telemetry hooks. Playback must support dry-run, simulated outputs, and real execution with clear audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: A searchable index UI in Console showing kitshelf items with tags and usage stats
Commandlet schema: name, inputs (typed), permissions, telemetry hook, example invocation
A playback engine able to assemble 1..n commandlets into a flow, run in dry-run mode and execute for real with audit log entry
RBAC gating: only roles with 'ops:execute' can perform live execution; dry-run allowed for broader roles
End-to-end telemetry: per-step timing, success/failure, and tokenized diff of side effects stored to observability backend
Integration tests covering idempotency for at least 8 frequently used commandlets
comments: 2025-02-12 Sofia Malik: Kickoff - scoped MVP focused on network & service restart commandlets, key-value cache flush, and log-rotate helper. Drafted initial schema and UX sketch. Linked PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Kitshelf+PRD

2025-02-14 Aisha Nwosu: Spike complete - prototyped playback harness and a protobuf-like schema for step inputs. Found trade-off: strict typing simplifies replay but increases on-boarding cost for contributors.

2025-02-15 Ethan Park (review): Prefer JSON Schema v7 for step validation rather than custom protobuf to keep contributor friction low. Suggest adding example fixtures for each commandlet. Filing follow-up task ENG-426790 to convert two sample commandlets.
2025-02-16 Design review (Maya Chen): Console cards should surface last-run result, owner, and a short safety checklist. Provided Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/kitshelf-cards

2025-02-18 Engineering update (Aisha Nwosu): Implemented index API and basic Console list view. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kitshelf/pull/212 - needs security review for exec endpoint. Running integration tests in CI (coverage: 62%).

2025-02-19 Security (Jordan Li): Quick security read — exec endpoints must require two-step approval for high-impact commandlets. Marked five commandlets as high-impact; added requirement to acceptance criteria.
notes: Decision log: MVP will ship with a curated set of 12 commandlets. We'll postpone an extensible community-contrib model until we have runtime sandboxing. Telemetry will be routed through the existing ops-telemetry ingestion so dashboards can be re-used. Consider follow-up for automatic rollbacks for destructive steps.
